narrative.overview: PTU Advisor is an operate-mode analytics workspace built for repeated inspection and comparison. Its near-black canvas, cool layered panels, compact controls, and tabular numeric typography prioritize state, evidence, and economics over decorative expression. The interface stays restrained so recommendation and warning colors remain meaningful. Direction contract provenance: FORM: Operate-mode financial control room, preserved incumbent system; seed key: ptu-operational-control-room. Reproduced with Impeccable 4.1.1 using --scope direction --mode operate --from ptu-operational-control-room --candidate-count 7: round 0, assigned position 7 of 7, local approved-pool revision 6c20a02b6dc4. This records the roll behind the existing direction; it does not establish a new visual direction.
keyCharacteristics: Broad analytical canvas with dense but orderly evidence
Cool neutral surfaces with one blue interaction accent
Semantic green, amber, and muted status treatments
Flat chart surfaces without decorative top stripes
Monospaced numerals for measured and financial values

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates interaction; green and amber communicate decision state. Decorative gradients never borrow those meanings.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Analytical cards remain visually quiet at rest. Elevation may clarify interaction, but it must not compete with the data.

dos: Do use the broad canvas for charts, metrics, and economic comparisons.
Do cap prose near 72 characters and keep numeric values tabular.
Do preserve visible demo provenance and pricing-source context.
Do keep mobile chart labels inside the canvas and move long legends into scrolling controls.
donts: Don't add decorative chart-top gradients, thick informational stripes, or glow effects.
Don't use status colors for decoration.
Don't truncate a selected commitment term without preserving its full accessible value.
Don't collapse desktop chart grids into a narrow reading column.
